name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with go-karting, fueled by his father's stories of rally racing. After excelling in mechanical engineering, he joined a local racing team, quickly rising through the ranks to become a key figure in their engine development program. His expertise in thermodynamics and fluid dynamics makes him invaluable for optimizing engine performance and cooling systems.

At Peugeot TotalEnergies, Ahmad is known for his hands-on approach and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues under pressure. He prioritizes data-driven decision-making and fosters a collaborative environment within his team. What distinguishes him is his ability to translate cutting-edge research into practical solutions on the track, ensuring that the team remains at the forefront of technological innovation.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Ahmad has a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating all measuring instruments himself before a race.
